question: What division of eightfold groups is sought to be known fully and exhaustively?
premises: There is a division into eightfold groups
The aim is to know it fully
The knowing is to be exhaustive
inference: The speaker seeks complete and exhaustive knowledge of the division into eightfold groups
uncertainties: anantathā may mean in infinite ways rather than endlessly
plain_english: I wish to know fully and exhaustively the division into eightfold groups.
